title: Schreib Calender
author: Johannes Kepler
full_title: Schreib Calender, Auff das Jahr nach deß Herren Christi vnsers Erlösers Geburt M. D. XCVIII
source: Kepler's writing calendar for 1598, the fourth he made at Graz as mathematician to the Estates of Styria, printed there in the autumn of 1597 by Hans Schmidt. Of his six Graz calendars it is the only one whose calendar survives; the copy is in the Steiermärkische Landesbibliothek, Graz.
transcribed_from: the facsimile in Johannes Kepler, *Gesammelte Werke*, vol. 11.2, *Calendaria et Prognostica*, ed. Volker Bialas and Helmuth Grössing (Munich, 1993), pp. 19–35, which the Bavarian Academy of Sciences publishes [online](https://publikationen.badw.de/de/008831995) under a CC BY licence. The photographs are cropped from it.
summary: The calendar Kepler made for Styria for 1598: a page for each month giving the saints' days and feasts, the Moon's daily place in the zodiac, the phases of the Moon to the minute, the planets' entries into the signs, the days good and bad for bloodletting, bathing, sowing and weaning, and a forecast of the weather, with the Sunday Gospels and woodcuts in the margin.
